headlines.title: Chevron to Shed Hess Midstream Stake in Major Bakken Restructuring
headlines.summary: Chevron has agreed to divest its ownership interests in Hess Midstream and its crude oil midstream assets in the DJ Basin as the U.S. supermajor looks to slash transportation and processing costs in the Bakken.

headlines.title: Chevron to Divest its Ownership Interests in Hess Midstream and DJ Basin Crude Midstream Assets
headlines.summary: HOUSTON, October 06, 2026--Chevron Corporation (NYSE: CVX) announced today that several of its subsidiaries have entered into a series of definitive agreements with Hess Midstream LP (NYSE: HESM) to restructure the terms of its Bakken midstream contracts and establish new DJ Basin midstream contracts. The revised agreements extend the Bakken contracts and are expected to reduce Chevron's Bakken unit midstream costs by approximately 50%, enhancing future earnings and return on capital employed.

headlines.title: Chevron names insider CFO amid leadership shifts
headlines.summary: Long-time Chevron executive Jeff Gustavson will receive a base salary of $1 million when he assumes its top finance seat in January, the oil company said.

headlines.title: Chevron Strengthens Namibia Position Ahead of Nabba-1X Well
headlines.summary: CVX increases the PEL 90 stake ahead of Nabba-1X, signaling confidence in the Namibia acreage and its exploration potential.

headlines.title: CHINESE MANUFACTURER FULLGOOD MOTOR MAKES ITS UNITED STATES DEBUT AT LOS ANGELES AUTO SHOW, SEEKING AMERICAN MANUFACTURING AND DISTRIBUTION PARTNERS
headlines.summary: Los Angeles Auto Show®, presented this year by Chevron with Techron®, today announced that FullGood Motor, the Beijing manufacturer of retro-styled plug-in hybrid vehicles, will exhibit in the United States for the first time during November's 2026 show. Citing robust sales in the Chinese market, FullGood Motor is coming to AutoMobility LA®, the show's global media and industry day on Thursday, Nov. 19, to meet potential American manufacturing and distribution partners and to talk to investors.

description: Chevron Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the integrated energy and chemicals operations. It operates through Upstream and Downstream segments. The Upstream segment engages in the exploration for, development, production, and transportation of crude oil and natural gas; processing, liquefaction, transportation, and regasification of liquefied natural gas; transportation of crude oil through pipelines; transportation, storage, and marketing of natural gas; carbon capture and storage; and operation of a gas-to-liquids plant. The Downstream segment refines crude oil into petroleum products; markets crude oil, refined products, and lubricants; manufactures and markets renewable fuels; transports crude oil and refined products through pipeline, marine vessel, motor equipment, and rail car; and manufactures and markets commodity petrochemicals, plastics for industrial uses, and fuel and lubricant additives. The company operates in North America, South America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. The company was formerly known as ChevronTexaco Corporation and changed its name to Chevron Corporation in May 2005. Chevron Corporation was founded in 1879 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
